styleLock.direction: premium cool-grey women's active-casual apparel ecommerce
styleLock.backgroundSystem: matte seamless paper cyclorama in cool studio white #FFFFFF and fog blue-grey #E7EAEE for on-body screens, one pale plaster tone #DCE0E5 reserved for the lifestyle screen, one graphite #22252A field reserved for macro and closing screens; flat fields only, no gradient, no environmental props beyond the lifestyle mirror edge
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright cool high-key studio light from a large frontal softbox with a right fill card, low skimming side light only where the closure line, rib band and hood relief must read, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars, no coloured gels
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte seamless paper floor and wall in a matching cool tone, graphite matte board carrying pale mist #EDEFF1 panels for macro and closing flat layouts, no wood, no warm stone, no sand or foliage
styleLock.typography: modern grotesque sans-serif, single family with tight tracking, one headline plus short labels, all rendered copy left as empty reserved space, no serif, script or hand lettering
styleLock.iconSystem: single-weight thin line icons and dotted leader lines in chrome silver #9EAAB6, unlettered rounded callout pills and empty stamp frames, no filled glyphs, no badges, no stars
styleLock.presentationRules: on-body garment kept at a stable straight-on or slight 3/4 angle with an identical crop line, hood, hem band and front closure always fully readable, model always generic with the face cropped or turned away, no mannequin, no floating garment, garment never re-proportioned between screens
noDrift: no colour palette changes away from #FFFFFF, #E7EAEE, #22252A and #9EAAB6
no mixed fonts or handwritten type
no random backgrounds, warm surfaces or gradient backdrops
no inconsistent lighting, coloured gels or warm cast between screens
no filled icons, badges, stars or certification seals
no identifiable model face, phone brand mark or hangtag lettering
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium cool-grey women's active-casual apparel visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cool studio white #FFFFFF, fog blue-grey seamless #E7EAEE, graphite #22252A and one chrome silver accent #9EAAB6; bright cool high-key studio lighting from a large frontal softbox with a right fill card, low skimming side light only where the closure line, rib band and hood relief must read, soft contact shadows and no harsh speculars; modern grotesque sans-serif with tight tracking; single-weight thin-line icon style in chrome silver with dotted leader lines, unlettered rounded callout pills and empty stamp frames; matte seamless paper cyclorama and graphite matte board surfaces, no gradient and no warm surfaces; clean high-end apparel photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable straight-on or slight 3/4 on-body garment angle with identical crop line, drape and scale, model always generic with the face cropped or turned away; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一眼拿下点击，用冷白底交代短款衣长与开襟结构。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level on-body framing, cropped from the collar to the hip, front closure running down the vertical centre
shots.lighting: bright cool high-key studio light, large frontal softbox with a right fill card, soft contact shadow at the hem
shots.props: none, only plain bottoms in matte charcoal #23262B worn underneath
shots.whitespace: none, the figure fills the frame
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce on-body packshot of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The garment worn and photographed straight-on at eye level, framed from the collar to the hip so the front closure runs down the vertical centre and the short hem band reads clearly, head cropped above the collarbone. Bright cool high-key studio light from a large frontal softbox with a right fill card, only a soft contact shadow where the hem meets the body line. Matte seamless backdrop #FFFFFF. Bottoms underneath in matte charcoal #23262B, nothing branded. No props. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame with no extra whitespace. 8K commercial apparel quality. Negative: no recognisable face, no hangtag or wordmark lettering, no second garment as co-subject, no jewellery sparkle, no gradient background, no cut-off sleeve or hem, no floating garment without a contact shadow.

shots.intent: 一秒给出核心利益：衣长齐腰、双手可插袋，主图一秒法则。
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle from a low vantage at hip height looking gently upward, half-figure from hem to hood, both hands resting at the pocket openings
shots.lighting: bright frontal softbox key with a low skimming side sweep from camera right lifting the closure line and the rib band
shots.props: one unlettered rounded callout pill floating clear of the silhouette
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the right 40% for copy
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The garment shown open at a slight 3/4 angle from a low vantage at hip height with the camera looking gently upward, half-figure framed from the hem band to the hood and both hands resting at the pocket openings. Bright frontal softbox key with a low skimming side sweep from camera right that reads the closure line and the ribbed hem. Seamless backdrop #E7EAEE. One empty unlettered rounded callout pill sits clear of the silhouette. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame, leaving generous negative space on the right 40% for copy. Negative: no lettering rendered inside the callout pill, no more than one claim, no invented fabric weight or stretch rating, no face, no limb distorted by the low vantage, no harsh specular sheen, no palette drift.

shots.intent: 用买家自拍视角完成上身代入，证明短款配高腰下装的日常比例。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level mirror reflection framing, slightly off-axis, figure cropped just below the chin
shots.lighting: soft interior daylight balance at 5600K from camera left, gentle falloff, faint floor contact shadow
shots.background: pale plaster wall #DCE0E5 behind a slim unframed mirror edge
shots.props: a plain hand-held phone at chest height, one small folded towel hook out of focus
shots.whitespace: none, the reflection fills the frame
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} worn and captured as a mirror reflection. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level mirror framing turned slightly off-axis, the figure cropped just below the chin so no facial identity appears, one hand holding a plain dark phone at chest height and the other hand lifting the hem edge to show the crop length. Soft interior daylight at 5600K from camera left with gentle falloff and a faint contact shadow on the floor. Pale plaster wall #DCE0E5 behind a slim unframed mirror edge. Props: a plain hand-held phone and one small folded towel hook far out of focus. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame with no extra whitespace. Negative: no recognisable face, no phone brand mark or readable camera module, no hand blocking the front closure, no duplicated or warped reflection figure, no cluttered shelf items, no watermark.

shots.intent: 微距特写做工，证明门襟闭合与罗纹收边的织造品质。
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro at a low side angle, lens skimming just above the surface, tight zoom on the centre-front closure and its pull tab with the ribbed cuff band in the foreground
shots.lighting: low skimming side light from camera right modelling the knit face and the pull tab, no specular blowout
shots.background: graphite matte field #22252A falling out of focus behind the focal point
shots.whitespace: minimal, the texture is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of the front closure zone of {product}, tight zoom on the centre-front fastener and its pull tab meeting the ribbed cuff band. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The lens skims just above the surface in an extreme close-up macro stance at a low side angle, shallow depth of field with the nearest stitch line sharp. Low skimming side light from camera right modelling the knit face and the pull tab without any specular blowout. Graphite matte field #22252A with the surrounding fabric falling softly out of focus. The macro detail occupies 55-60% of the frame and the remaining space is defocused fabric, so there is no extra whitespace. Negative: no blurry subject at the focal point, no plastic-looking synthetic sheen, no loose threads or pilling presented as the subject, no repeated knit pattern, no label lettering, no invented hardware shape, no watermark.

shots.intent: 用同框侧身与背侧双面板回答袖长、帽型与后背长度疑虑。
shots.camera: two matched panels with identical crop line: left photographed from a clean 90-degree side profile, right photographed from behind at a 45-degree rear angle
shots.lighting: bright cool key matched across both panels with a soft rim skimming the hood curve and a low open fill on the shadow side
shots.background: fog blue-grey seamless #E7EAEE across both panels
shots.whitespace: even margins between the two panels, no extra whitespace
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce structure detail of {product}, two matched panels side by side with an identical crop line and identical scale. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Left panel photographed from a clean 90-degree side profile so sleeve length, hood depth and the short hem all read; right panel photographed from behind at a 45-degree rear angle so the hood, back yoke and sleeve setting read. Bright cool key light matched across both panels with a soft rim skimming the hood curve and a low open fill keeping the shadow side legible, one soft contact shadow at the hem. Seamless backdrop #E7EAEE across both panels. No props. Each panel of the garment occupies 45-50% of its own half with even margins and no extra whitespace. Negative: no face turned toward camera in either panel, no invented panels or extra seams, no mismatched lighting or scale between the two halves, no tangled drawcords, no size tab lettering, no watermark.

shots.lighting: identical bright cool key across all three units, matched soft contact shadows, no lighting drift

Three units of the same garment paired straight-on at eye level with identical scale, identical pose and identical crop line; the centre unit carries the colourway from the reference while the outer two are neutral placeholder colourways to be replaced by the real range, one in deep graphite #22252A and one in pale mist #EDEFF1. Bright cool key light matched across all three units with identical soft contact shadows and no lighting drift. Seamless backdrop #FFFFFF. No props. The row of three units occupies 60-70% of the frame overall with even margins between the units. Negative: no invented colour names or swatch lettering, no hue shift away from the supplied reference, no mixed lighting or mismatched scale between units, no third pose, no dropped fastener detail, no watermark.

Photographed from a high 45-degree overhead angle looking down on a styled flat layout: the garment laid front-up with the closure partially open, folded plain bottoms in matte charcoal #23262B beside it, one pair of unbranded chunky sneakers along the lower edge and one empty rounded call-to-action pill in chrome silver #9EAAB6. provenance.notes: 源 5 张逐图事实：01 冷白底半身，门襟半开、一手捏着帽绳金属头，下身穿深色紧身裤；02 冷浅灰无缝棚正身偏 3/4，外套全开、双手各插一只斜插袋，内搭短款背心；03 白色弧面道具前的对镜自拍，一手举深色手机、一手掀起下摆；04 冷浅灰底侧身 90 度站姿，罗纹袖口与短下摆清楚；05 冷浅灰底背面全身，帽摊在后背，下身穿深色紧身裤与厚底运动鞋。品类判定：五张图同为同一件上身的多角度分镜（正面/半开插袋/自拍/侧面/背面），并非同构图换色换码的色卡陈列，故不构成变体画廊，正常转化；据图判定 L1 女装、L2 上衣，leaf 取女式短款全拉链连帽卫衣（开襟上衣类，本库 L2 无卫衣一项，故归上衣）。已剥离：原品牌字标与系列名、原平台店铺字样、模特面容与身份（全部改为下巴以下裁切、侧脸背向或背影）、源图无任何图内文案故 textZone 全为 none、手机与鞋底等一切可识别标记、任何评分角标与平台徽章；产品一律以 {product} 占位。色板与背景体系另建为冷雪白-雾蓝灰-石墨深灰-铬银强调的冷调棚场系统，与本库暖白燕麦系抓绒卫衣模版在色板、台面与机位体系上完全区分。
